# Export file icons

Unmodified Microsoft Fluent UI file-type SVG assets, 48 px variants, and the
original Adobe Acrobat SVG used on Adobe's website.
These identify export formats, not an affiliation with Microsoft or Adobe.
ZIP uses a file-type icon; ZIP does not have a single product logo.

- https://res.cdn.office.net/files/fabric-cdn-prod_20260623.001/assets/item-types/48/xlsx.svg
- https://res.cdn.office.net/files/fabric-cdn-prod_20260623.001/assets/item-types/48/zip.svg
- https://main--federal--adobecom.aem.page/federal/assets/svgs/acrobat-pro.svg (acrobat.svg)
- https://www.adobe.com/ (source page for the Acrobat SVG)

Official source package and CDN configuration:
- https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui/blob/master/packages/react-file-type-icons/src/initializeFileTypeIcons.tsx
- https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui/blob/master/packages/style-utilities/src/cdn.ts

Assets are bundled locally, with no runtime CDN request.
